product.title: Tremsil® 200
product.description: A single-component acetoxy silicone sealant that cures to a flexible rubber when exposed to moisture present in the air, creating a weathertight seal.
features: Sensitive Environment Use through GREENGUARD Gold Certification, including kitchen, spa, and bathroom applications
Cures to a flexible, weathertight rubber seal
Easy Application with conventional caulking equipment with no mixing requirement
Multi-Use through adhesion to glass, metal, porcelain, ceramic and most painted surfaces
Faster Installation with a skin time of only 20 minutes
